thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT OPENED: KV-cache eviction storm detected -> continuous-batching backlog. High p95 and elevated error rates across prod. Pager routed to #eng-oncall. See dashboard: https://mon.redwood/INC-2345 :rotating_light:
oncall-alex: On it. pulling up dashboards now. Which clusters/regions affected?
sre-maya: us-west-2 primary, some noise in eu-west-1. P95 tok/sec spiked ~3.2x, 5xx rate up to 0.9% on /v1/generate. KV eviction rate jumped 12x.
eng-runtime-ben: Looks like a sudden working set growth for tenant `acme-prod` caused very large KV cache churn. continuous-batching queue backed up (queue depth > 12k).
oncall-alex: any recent deploys?
eng-ml-sam: small rollout last night adjusted KV prefetch heuristics + increased default batch window from 16 -> 48 for perf gains. suspect we opened a regression on tail.
product-lina: FYI Acme is on Dedicated and is in onboarding. CSM already got an alert from them.
customer-jones: we are seeing many timeouts and partial responses, some requests return 522. sending a few request ids in DM.
eng-runtime-ben: mitigation options: 1) immediate per-tenant throttle (limit batch size / reduce batch window for acme-prod) 2) rollback heuristics change globally 3) enable per-tenant fallback to smaller model variant. prefer 1) to avoid global impact.
oncall-alex: Agreed. Can someone run the per-tenant throttle? we have a runbook. I'll take it if someone confirms command.
eng-runtime-ben: use admin tool:
```
infractl flags set batch_window --tenant acme-prod --value 8 --reason "live mitigation: eviction storm"
# or to hard cap concurrent batches
infractl tenant-config set acme-prod max_concurrent_batches=4
```
oncall-alex: executing first command now.
incident-bot: ACTION: infractl flags set batch_window --tenant acme-prod --value 8 executed by oncall-alex (runbook: /runbooks/kv-eviction-mitigation).
sre-maya: watching metrics... p95 down from 1.6s -> 900ms within 60s, queue depth falling. error rate trending down.
eng-ml-sam: nice. can we do a controlled canary across top 5 tenants for 5m to ensure no other tenants will trigger similar behavior?
oncall-alex: yes planning canary: apply same flag to top-5 by qps one at a time, 2m gap. Will automate via script.
eng-runtime-ben: script: `for t in $(top-tenants); do infractl flags set batch_window --tenant $t --value 8; sleep 120; done`
product-lina: I'll notify Acme CSM with a brief note that we've applied a temporary throttle and are monitoring - avoid alarming them with rollback language.
customer-jones: thanks, latency already looks better on our side. we still see a couple of 5xx but much fewer.
sre-maya: note: eviction spikes correlate with a specific query pattern that causes high prefix miss rate. we should capture examples for postmortem.
eng-ml-sam: +1 collect sample inputs and model traces (anonymize) before rolling further flags.
oncall-alex: ok pausing canary until we have one sample trace. @eng-runtime-ben can you grab one?
eng-runtime-ben: grabbed one and uploaded to /s3/runs/INC-2345/traces/trace-001.json (redacted). linking in ticket.
incident-bot: MONITORING: rolling windows show continued improvement. p95 stable at ~750ms, 5xx at 0.15%.
eng-runtime-ben: next step: push a per-tenant emergency cap in config service to avoid future single-tenant blasts. propose default `max_concurrent_batches=8` and per-tenant override for heavy customers.
product-lina: agree. also recommend adding an SLA note for Dedicated customers about recommended usage patterns and a wavy limit during onboarding.
eng-ml-sam: for long term: revert or tweak prefetch heuristics and add adaptive batch window based on eviction feedback.
oncall-alex: Good. preparing handoff to eng-runtime for RCA and followup. oncall shift handoff scheduled at 1945006820.
sre-maya: I'll keep the incident open for 1h and then close if metrics stable; will add alert suppression to avoid noisy repeats.
eng-runtime-ben: capturing action items: 1) revert/tweak prefetch change in dev branch 2) add per-tenant caps + deploy 3) collect inputs for RCA 4) postmortem doc + customer outreach draft.
product-lina: will draft customer communication for Acme and any potentially affected tenants.
customer-jones: appreciate the quick response. please share postmortem when ready.
noncall-alex: thanks team. great work moving fast without a global rollback. handing to @eng-runtime-ben for RCA follow-up.
eng-runtime-ben: acknowledged, taking over. will open INC-2345 ticket and assign owners.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigation applied; monitoring indicates recovery. incident will remain open for postmortem.
sre-maya: logging final note: put emergency per-tenant cap config behind feature flag and add alert at 6x eviction baseline.
noncall-alex: handoff complete. I'll be reachable for followups. :thumbsup:
